lexicalDecisions.decision: Only necessary new support is 冒すおかす, selected braving-risk sense with 危険を冒すきけんをおかす. The standalone verb is transitive godan; retain recognition of disease/chemical harm, desecration and surname senses without forcing every occurrence into risk-taking. 病に冒される is passive: being afflicted, not a patient voluntarily braving illness.

Reuse existing 冒険ぼうけん, N3 vocabulary metadata unchanged. 冒頭ぼうとう, 冒涜ぼうとく and 感冒かんぼう may provide short qualified recognition notes; they do not justify three extra support articles or require the risk gloss in every compound.

侵すおかす concerns invading/infringing and has a harm sense cross-referencing 冒す. 犯すおかす covers committing an offense, rule-breaking and other senses. Teach useful 危険を冒す versus 罪を犯す without an absolute one-spelling/one-semantic-domain rule. Neither homophone currently has a word article to reuse; a shared reading is not a matching lexical identity.

Propose direct exclusions from new 冒す to 壊す/害/損害/被害 for broad displayed damage/harm labels and the source's disease/chemical-harm sense, and to 冒険 for venture/risk overlap. These are conservative label safeguards, not assertions that the Japanese constructions or noun/verb roles are freely interchangeable. Existing metadata/exclusions remain unchanged.

Danger/at-risk evaluation is not itself braving risk; exploration need not foreground danger. 攻める's taking-on/boldness sense is related, not established as an unrestricted synonym of 冒す. No automatic exclusion clique from shared subject matter. 険's raw ケン and existing compound explanation support the other component in 冒険.

寒冒 and 眩冒 are search-only spellings, not ordinary reading examples. 冒瀆 is rare-spelling information whereas 冒讀 is search-only; the adjective family has its own different spelling flags. 冒険資本 is explicitly rare. Keep these full families but select none as practice, and infer no rarity from missing priority flags alone.
Product/work titles are retained because the selection includes every 冒 family, not selected as necessary support or proof of general-word frequency.

shapeAndRadical.futureTeaching: Use structure-unclassified and an explicitly labelled modern-shape mnemonic: stacked upper boxlike outline over 目. Explain where indexing 冂 appears. Do not claim that every typeface joins the upper horizontal strokes or that it is historically composed of sun plus eye.
